prompt: Origin: photo cutout of Riptide v2 (black plates, googly eyes, sponsor stickers) from the Into the Deep (2024-25) robot page of the Seattle Solvers Google Site (sites.google.com/view/seattlesolvers/robots/into-the-deep-2024-25), fetched 2026-09-27; its flat #FDF9DE background keyed to transparency (the border-connected field plus the enclosed openings that are exactly that fill; the white and cream parts of the robot stay), 3px soft colour-decontaminated edge, trimmed, resized to 1100px tall, webp with alpha.
